lint-llm-diff.command: judge_tmp=$(mktemp -d -t lj.XXXXXX) || { echo "lint-llm-diff: no temporary directory could be made for the judge; make TMPDIR (or /tmp) a writable directory with free space, then retry" >&2; exit 1; }; trap 'chmod -R u+rwx -- "$judge_tmp" || echo "lint-llm-diff: not everything under $judge_tmp could be made removable" >&2; rm -rf -- "$judge_tmp" || echo "lint-llm-diff: the temporary directory $judge_tmp handed to the judge could not be removed; remove it by hand with rm -rf" >&2' EXIT; TMPDIR="$judge_tmp" TMP="$judge_tmp" TEMP="$judge_tmp" llmlint --diff --diff-base "$LLMLINT_DIFF_BASE_SHA"
